steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; $tracker = AryanX\Axle\LicenseTracker\Plugin::instance()->tracker(); $tracker->sync(); $ids = get_posts( array( 'post_type' => 'alc_license', 'numberposts' => 1, 'fields' => 'ids', 'meta_key' => '_alc_component', 'meta_value' => 'plugin:demo-pro-forms/demo-pro-forms.php' ) ); if ( $ids ) { foreach ( array( '_alc_renewal' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d', time() + 12 * DAY_IN_SECONDS ), '_alc_cost' => 7900, '_alc_currency' => 'USD', '_alc_cycle' => 'yearly', '_alc_owner' => 'Bean There' ) as $key => $value ) { update_post_meta( $ids[0], $key, $value ); } }
